common.disclaimer: Migrano is a self-observation diary, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice. Talk to your doctor about what you log.

home.title: Migrano
home.tapToEdit: Tap to add details or end it
home.empty: No attacks logged yet. When one starts, tap the button — details can wait.
home.medWarnBody: You chose to be told at {{n}} days. Frequent acute medication is worth discussing with your doctor.

meds.title: Medication
meds.sub: Your own preparations, by name. Migrano never suggests medicines or doses.
meds.name: Name
meds.acuteHint: Only acute medication counts towards medication days.

insights.title: Insights
insights.lockedBody: Attack days per month, average duration and intensity, and which triggers and symptoms come up most — plus the PDF report for your doctor.
insights.attackDaysPerMonth: Attack days per month, last 12 months
insights.disclaimer: Shares are simple counts of what you logged, not evidence of cause.

report.title: Headache diary report
report.sub: A one-page summary plus one row per attack, formatted for a doctor's visit.
report.footer: Created with {{app}} — a self-observation diary, not a medical device

notif.checkinBody: A 5-second check-in keeps your diary complete.
notif.openBody: An attack has been open for 24 hours. Tap to set the end time.

lock.title: Enter PIN
lock.hint: Your diary is locked. Enter your 4–6 digit PIN.

settings.medThreshold: Tell me about medication days at
settings.medThresholdHint: Many guidelines mention 10 or 15 days per month as a point to raise with a doctor. Pick what yours uses.
settings.openEpisodeReminder: Remind me if an attack stays open for 24 h
settings.pinOn: On — asked after 1 minute in the background
settings.pinHint: There is no way to recover a forgotten PIN — only deleting all data unlocks the app.
settings.dataNote: Everything stays on this phone. The backup file is encrypted with your passphrase and shared by you — never uploaded by us.
settings.freeHint: Unlimited logging. Pro adds insights, the PDF report and the PIN lock.

backup.passphrase: Choose a passphrase for the backup file
backup.importHint: Newest entry wins when the same attack exists on both phones.
backup.wrongApp: This backup belongs to another app
backup.importFailed: Could not import — wrong passphrase or file?
backup.wipeConfirm: This permanently deletes everything stored in the app on this device. Exported backup files are not affected. Continue?

steps.title: One tap when it starts
steps.body: "Attack now" starts the clock. Intensity, triggers and medication can wait until you feel better.

steps.title: Private by design
steps.body: No account, no cloud, no tracking. Your diary lives on this phone, and only you can export it.

steps.title: Made for the doctor's visit
steps.body: Attack days, medication days, triggers and a PDF report — the things a neurologist actually asks for.
